newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan Exim bank lends $100 mln to China airport.
newsitem.headline: Japan Exim bank lends $100 mln to China airport.

text.p: China has obtained a $100 million loan from the Import-Export Bank of Japan to finance construction of an airport on the island of Hainan, the Hainan Special Zone News said.
The Bank of China is the borrower and will use the funds to finance the Meilan airport on the southern island, the newspaper said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.
The loan was the first batch of a $141 million loan package promised by the Import-Export Bank of Japan to Hainan linked to the airport, it said.
The loan would be used for purchasing construction materials, lighting equipment, navigation and power supply systems and a jet fuel supply system for the airport, it said.
Construction on the airport has been in progress since November 1995, it said. Total investment in the project has reached 267 million yuan ($32 million) so far.
